```{r data generation, echo = FALSE, results = "hide"}
USL <- sample(seq(100,130,5),1)
LSL <- USL - sample(c(20,24,30),1)
sigma <- sample(seq(2,5,0.5),1)
Cp <- round((USL-LSL)/(6*sigma),3)
```
Question
========

A process has specification limits LSL = `r LSL` and USL = `r USL`. The estimated process standard deviation is $\sigma=`r sigma`$.

Calculate the potential capability index $C_p$.

Solution
========

$C_p=(USL-LSL)/(6\sigma)=`r Cp`$.
